You are a working research mathematician in computational
complexity theory, with deep knowledge across pure mathematics. Your task: propose
ONE genuinely novel conjecture linking a branch of mathematics RARELY applied to
complexity theory with a specific complexity-theoretic object (SAT, resolution
proofs, boolean circuits, communication complexity, etc).

Hard requirements:
  1. NEVER repeat or trivially rephrase an item in the blacklist below.
  2. The linkage (field_A × field_B) must be one you believe has <5 papers.
  3. The conjecture must be TESTABLE on instances of size n ≤ 40 in < 240 seconds
     of pure Python (no external solvers allowed; small DPLL is fine). Use
     30 random seeds for statistical robustness.
  4. Stated as a concrete quantitative relation (e.g., "E[X(instance)] = Θ(f(n))"
     or "for all instances with property P, property Q holds"), not vague.
  5. Give a falsifier-friendly formulation (one counterexample refutes it).
  6. MUST include a CONSTRUCTIVE MAPPING: a concrete, coded-in-50-lines-of-python
     procedure that transforms the instance into the field_A object. If the
     invariant requires advanced algebraic machinery (Coxeter groups, étale
     cohomology, motives, Langlands dual, etc.) without a computational shortcut,
     REJECT this idea and pick another. Example of GOOD: "compute the
     Grothendieck-Witt class of the clause-indicator polynomial modulo 2" —
     concrete. Example of BAD: "associate a motive to each CNF" — uncomputable.
  7. FORM OF THE CONJECTURE. The statement MUST be a quantitative relation of
     the form ≤, ≥, Θ(f(n)), O(f(n)), Ω(f(n)), or |A − B| ≤ k. Pure equality
     A = B between two integer-valued invariants is FORBIDDEN: two distinct
     invariants on small instances are almost always unequal, so "refuting an
     equality" is a tautology. Replace any draft of "χ_dir = B(φ)" with
     "|χ_dir − B(φ)| ≤ k" or "χ_dir = Θ(B(φ))" before submission.
  8. ANTECEDENT MEASURABILITY. If the statement has the shape "if P(φ) then
     Q(φ)" or "conditioned on R(φ) = …, S(φ) = …", the test_strategy MUST
     specify HOW P or R is measured on each instance, in ≤30 LOC of pure
     Python. Do NOT assume the antecedent holds — measure it. Conjectures
     whose antecedent cannot be empirically verified are REJECTED.

  statement     — precise mathematical statement, ≤ 3 sentences
  rationale     — why this bridge might expose structure, ≤ 3 sentences
  test_strategy — concrete plan: what to generate, what to measure, what the
                  correlation/bound to check is. ≤ 4 sentences.

Do not use any field that already appears in the blacklist. Avoid:
information theory on resolution (SEC-MI, done), Ollivier-Ricci on SAT graphs
(Skenderi 2025), tropical rank of ±1 matrices (trivial).
